The instance ID. You can view the current instance ID on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID exists, you must provide it; otherwise, the call will fail.
- If there is no **Instance Overview** page or ID, you do not need to provide this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
数据目的操作类型，可取值：

- **REPUBLISH**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至物联网平台的另一个通信Topic。
- **AMQP**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据流转到AMQP消费组。
- **DATAHUB**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云DataHub，进行流式数据处理。
- **ONS**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据转发至阿里云消息队列RocketMQ，进行消息分发。
- **MNS**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云消息服务中，进行消息传输。
- **FC**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云函数计算服务，进行事件计算。
- **OTS**：将解析器脚本处理后的Topic数据发送至阿里云表格存储（Tablestore），进行NoSQL数据存储。
description.en:
The operation type of the data destination. Valid values:

- **REPUBLISH**: Forward the topic data processed by the resolver script to another communication topic in the IoT Platform.
- **AMQP**: Forward the topic data processed by the resolver script to an AMQP consumer group.
- **DATAHUB**: Forward the topic data processed by the resolver script to Alibaba Cloud DataHub for stream data processing.
- **ONS**: Forward the topic data processed by the resolver script to Alibaba Cloud Message Queue for Apache RocketMQ for message distribution.
- **MNS**: Send the topic data processed by the resolver script to Alibaba Cloud Message Service for message transmission.
- **FC**: Send the topic data processed by the resolver script to Alibaba Cloud Function Compute for event-driven computing.
- **OTS**: Send the topic data processed by the resolver script to Alibaba Cloud Tablestore for NoSQL data storage.

title.en: Create a Resolver Stream Data Destination

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Queries per second (QPS) limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account invoking this API is 10.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
